description_en: Detaches tags from Anycast EIPs in a batch
description_zh: 调用UntagResources接口为指定的Anycast EIP资源批量解绑标签
kebab_example: aliyun eipanycast untag-resources --resource-id aeip-2zeerraiwb7ujsxdc0000 --resource-type ANYCASTEIPADDRESS --region cn-hangzhou
name: UntagResources

parameters.help_en: The resource IDs. You can detach tags from a maximum of 20 resource IDs
parameters.help_zh: 资源ID。最多支持解绑20个资源ID
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Set the value to ANYCASTEIPADDRESS
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The tag keys that you want to detach. You can enter a maximum of 20 tag keys. If you specify this parameter, the value cannot be an empty string.

A tag key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with aliyun or acs:. It also cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
要解绑的标签键。最多支持输入20个标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

一个标签键最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
parameters.name: tag_key

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:

true: The call was successful.

false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。取值：

true：调用成功。

false：调用失败
